name: Lebesgue space (Lebesgue probability space mod 0)
description: A probability space isomorphic mod null sets to an interval carrying Lebesgue measure together with at most countably many atoms.

name: Gauss measure
description: The probability measure dμ = (1/ln 2)·dx/(1+x) on [0,1) that is invariant under the Gauss (continued-fraction) map.

name: Induced (first-return) transformation T_A
description: For a measure-preserving T and a positive-measure set A, the map T_A(x)=T^{n_A(x)}(x) sending x to its first return to A, which preserves the normalized restriction of m to A.

name: First return-time function n_A
description: The function assigning to x∈A the least integer n≥1 with T^n x ∈ A, finite a.e. by Poincaré recurrence.

name: Kakutani–Rokhlin tower (skyscraper) construction
function_signature: (base map S on A, height/return function n) → (measure-preserving transformation T on the tower over A)
description: A method that builds a measure-preserving transformation by stacking iterates of a base map according to a return/height function over a base set.

name: Bernoulli shift
type_signature: (Π Y, B, Πp) → (Π Y, B, Πp)
description: The coordinate shift on a one- or two-sided product probability space equipped with the product measure of a fixed probability vector (p_0,…,p_{k-1}).

name: Markov shift
description: The coordinate shift on a sequence space whose measure is determined by a stochastic matrix P and a stationary probability vector p with pP=p.

name: Two-sided shift map σ
description: The coordinate-shift homeomorphism (σx)_n = x_{n+1} on a bi-infinite sequence space, preserving any shift-invariant measure.

name: Endomorphism/automorphism of a compact group (as m.p.t.)
description: A continuous surjective group homomorphism of a compact group, which preserves the normalized Haar measure.

name: Automorphism/endomorphism of the torus (matrix m.p.t.)
description: The map T(x)=Ax mod 1 on the n-torus induced by an integer matrix A, preserving Lebesgue measure (an automorphism when det A = ±1).

name: Isomorphism mod 0 (measure-theoretic isomorphism)
description: An invertible measure-preserving map between full-measure invariant subsets that conjugates two systems, the basic equivalence relation of ergodic theory.

name: Measure-algebra isomorphism (conjugacy of measure algebras)
description: A measure-preserving Boolean σ-algebra isomorphism between the measure algebras of two systems that intertwines the induced maps.

name: Spectral isomorphism (unitary equivalence of Koopman operators)
type_signature: W U_{T_1} = U_{T_2} W, W unitary
description: Existence of a unitary operator intertwining the Koopman operators of two systems, an equivalence strictly weaker than isomorphism mod 0.

name: Conjugacy implies spectral isomorphism
description: Measure-theoretically isomorphic systems have unitarily equivalent Koopman operators, while the converse fails.

name: Point spectrum (eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of U_T)
description: The set of λ for which the Koopman operator has a nonzero eigenfunction f with f∘T = λf a.e.

name: Eigenvalues of modulus one with constant-modulus eigenfunctions
description: For an ergodic transformation every eigenvalue has modulus one, eigenfunctions have constant modulus a.e., and the eigenvalues form a subgroup of the circle with eigenfunctions of distinct eigenvalues orthogonal.

name: Weak-mixing product characterization (T×T ergodic)
type_signature: T weak-mixing ⟺ T×T ergodic ⟺ T×T weak-mixing
description: A transformation is weak-mixing if and only if its Cartesian square is ergodic, equivalently the square is itself weak-mixing.

name: Weak-mixing ⇔ continuous spectrum (no nonconstant eigenfunctions)
type_signature: T weak-mixing ⟺ 1 is the only (simple) eigenvalue of U_T
description: A transformation is weak-mixing if and only if the constants are the only eigenfunctions of its Koopman operator, i.e. U_T has continuous spectrum on the orthocomplement of constants.

name: Weak-mixing equivalent to all powers ergodic
description: A transformation is weak-mixing if and only if every power Tⁿ is ergodic, and then every power is itself weak-mixing.

name: Koopman–von Neumann lemma
description: A bounded nonnegative sequence has Cesàro averages tending to zero if and only if it converges to zero along a subsequence of density one.

name: Ergodicity criterion for group rotations
type_signature: rotation by a on G ergodic ⟺ {aⁿ} dense
description: Rotation by an element a of a compact group G is ergodic with respect to Haar measure if and only if the cyclic subgroup generated by a is dense in G.

name: Ergodicity criterion for toral automorphisms
type_signature: A ergodic ⟺ no eigenvalue of A is a root of unity
description: A toral endomorphism given by integer matrix A is ergodic with respect to Lebesgue measure if and only if no eigenvalue of A is a root of unity.

name: Ergodicity and mixing of Bernoulli and Markov shifts
description: Bernoulli shifts are strong-mixing, and a Markov shift is ergodic if and only if its stochastic matrix is irreducible (mixing if aperiodic).

name: Fekete subadditive sequence lemma
type_signature: a_{m+n} ≤ a_m + a_n ⟹ lim a_n/n = inf a_n/n
description: For a subadditive real sequence the limit of a_n/n exists and equals the infimum of a_n/n.

name: Entropy of a transformation with respect to a partition h(T,ξ)
description: The asymptotic per-step entropy of the iterated joins of a partition under T, whose limit exists by subadditivity.

name: Measure-theoretic entropy of a transformation h(T)
description: The supremum of h(T,ξ) over all finite measurable partitions, an isomorphism invariant of the system.

name: Entropy behaviour under powers and inverses
description: Measure-theoretic entropy scales linearly under iteration and is invariant under inversion of an invertible transformation.

name: Generator (one-sided/two-sided)
description: A finite measurable partition whose iterated T-preimages (one-sided, or two-sided for invertible T) generate the full σ-algebra mod 0.

name: Join (refinement) of partitions ξ∨η
description: The common refinement of two partitions whose atoms are the nonempty intersections of an atom of each.

name: Basic entropy (in)equalities for partitions
description: Entropy of partitions satisfies the chain rule H(ξ∨η)=H(η)+H(ξ|η), subadditivity, monotonicity, and concavity in the partition.

name: Pinsker σ-algebra
description: The largest T-invariant sub-σ-algebra on which the transformation has zero entropy.

name: Space M(X) of Borel probability measures
description: The convex set of Borel probability measures on a compact metric space, compact and metrizable in the weak* topology.

name: Space M(X,T) of T-invariant probability measures
description: The nonempty compact convex subset of M(X) consisting of the T-invariant Borel probability measures of a continuous system.

name: Ergodic measures are the extreme points of M(X,T)
description: The ergodic invariant measures are exactly the extreme points of M(X,T), which is a Choquet simplex.

name: Bowen (dynamical) metric d_n
description: The metric measuring the maximal separation of two orbit segments over n iterates, used to define (n,ε)-separated and spanning sets.

name: L^p mean ergodic theorem
type_signature: f∈L^p ⟹ A_n f → f* in L^p
description: For 1≤p<∞ and f∈L^p, the Birkhoff averages converge in L^p norm to the conditional expectation onto the invariant σ-algebra.

name: Upper semicontinuity of the entropy map and existence of equilibrium states
type_signature: μ ↦ h_μ(T) u.s.c. ⟹ equilibrium states exist
description: When the map μ↦h_μ(T) is upper semicontinuous on M(X,T) (e.g. for expansive systems) the supremum in the variational principle is attained, so equilibrium states exist for every continuous potential.

name: Khinchin and Lévy constants for continued fractions
type_signature: a.e. x: (∏ a_i)^{1/n} → K, (1/n)log q_n → L
description: For Lebesgue-almost every x the geometric mean of the continued-fraction partial quotients converges to Khinchin's constant and the denominators grow at the Lévy constant rate, via Birkhoff applied to the ergodic Gauss map.

name: Eigenvalue group as complete invariant for discrete spectrum
type_signature: ergodic discrete-spectrum T_1 ≅ T_2 ⟺ equal eigenvalue groups
description: For ergodic transformations with discrete spectrum the subgroup of the circle formed by the eigenvalues is a complete invariant up to isomorphism.
